description_expanded: Overview5.0(2 reviews)Steps to deeded beach access - 2 bikes - Stunning carriage house `Casita Blanca`The Space Cozy Carriage House – Steps from the Beach! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Only 100 Yards to Private Beach Access – Enjoy easy strolls to the white sandy shores 2 FREE Bikes – Explore Seacrest, Alys Beach, & Rosemary Beach with ease Complimentary Wi-Fi – Stay connected while relaxing in paradise 2 King Bedrooms – Sleeps 4 comfortably, perfect for a small family or couples’ getaway 2 En Suite Bathrooms – Modern stand-up showers for added convenience Spacious Open-Concept Living Area – Cozy sitting area with HDTV and dining for two Fully Equipped Kitchen – Includes refrigerator, stove, oven, and microwave for easy meal prep 2 Gravel Parking Spaces Outside the Gate – Hassle-free parking for your stay Amazing Location – Close to Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach & The Hub Professionally Managed – 24/7 Guest ServiceWelcome to Casita BlancaWelcome to your 30A family getaway in this cozy carriage house in Seacrest Beach West. Boasting a kitchen, large living room and sleeping for 4. The open main living area includes a sitting area facing a large HDTV, a dinner table with seating for 2, and a brand-new kitchen including refrigerator, stove, oven, and microwave.Sleeping for 4 available between the 2 king bedrooms. Each bedroom has it's own en suite bathroom with state-of-the-art standup showers. This carriage house is just steps from the beach and located near Alys Beach, Seacrest and Rosemary to the east with The Hub located to the west.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (4):Master bedroom - King sized bed, en suite bathroom with standup showerGuest Bedroom - King sized bed, en suite bathroom with standup showerAREA ATTRACTIONS:This easygoing beach neighborhood is the perfect place to escape for a beach vacation. Spend a day wandering through the shops and sights of Seacrest — you’ll spot everything from gorgeous dune lakes to gourmet restaurants. Then, unwind with a stroll along Seacrest’s sugar-white sand.You can find historic Alys Beach 0.5 miles east. Slightly further east you can enjoy the lively community that gathers in Seacrest’s Peddler’s Pavilion. Sip coffee on an outdoor patio, stock up on homemade sweet treats, or rent a bicycle and go exploring. With wide-open green spaces and plenty of ecosploring opportunities, this beach neighborhood is a perfect fit for active vacationers.Show less
